tha-ap315:1.1: samattaṃ. [313. Gatasaññaka.] Ākāse* 'va* padaṃ n' atthi ambare anilañjase / Siddhatthaṃ jinaṃ adakkhiṃ gacchantaṃ tidivaṅgaṇaṃ. // //
tha-ap315:2.1: Anilen' eritaṃ disvā sammāsambuddhacīvaraṃ / vitti me tāvade jātā disvāna gamanaṃ mune. // // Catunavute
tha-ap315:3.1: ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap315:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Gatasaññako thero i. g. a-ti.
